content.text: Now let's stress-test performance at the maximum bounds (20 queries, 8 profiles, 16 zones, ~1024 records, 64 observations).

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/gen_stress.py <<'PY'
import json,random
rng=random.Random(1)
zones=[]
for zi in range(16):
    origin='z%d.test.'%zi
    recs=[]
    for r in range(64):
        owner='n%d.%s'%(r,origin)
        if r%8==0:
            recs.append({'owner':owner,'type':'CNAME','data':'t%d.%s'%(r,origin)})
        else:
            recs.append({'owner':owner,'type':rng.choice(['A','AAAA','TXT']),'data':rng.choice(['192.0.2.%d'%rng.randint(0,255),'2001:db8::%x'%rng.randint(1,100),'txt%d'%r])})
    zones.append({'origin':origin,'records':recs})
profiles=[]
for i in range(8):
    profiles.append({'id':'p%d'%i,'max_aliases':rng.randint(0,5),'cname':rng.choice(['follow','stop']),'wildcard':rng.choice(['rfc','off','one-label'])})
queries=[]
for i in range(20):
    zi=rng.randint(0,15); r=rng.randint(0,63)
    queries.append({'id':'q%02d'%i,'name':'n%d.z%d.test.'%(r,zi),'type':rng.choice(['A','AAAA','TXT','CNAME']),'cost':rng.randint(1,1000)})
obs=[]
for i in range(64):
    q=queries[rng.randint(0,19)]; p=profiles[rng.randint(0,7)]
    ans=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0,128)):
        t=rng.choice(['A','AAAA','TXT'])
        d={'A':'192.0.2.%d'%rng.randint(0,255),'AAAA':'2001:db8::%x'%rng.randint(1,1000),'TXT':'x'}[t]
        ans.append({'owner':'some.name.','type':t,'data':d})
    obs.append({'id':'o%02d'%i,'query':q['id'],'profile':p['id'],'result':{'status':'response','rcode':rng.choice(['NOERROR','NXDOMAIN','SERVFAIL','REFUSED']),'answer':ans}})
doc={'zones':zones,'profiles':profiles,'queries':queries,'observations':obs}
open('/workspace/tmp/stress.json','w').write(json.dumps(doc))
print(len(json.dumps(doc)))
PY
python3 /workspace/tmp/gen_stress.py
/usr/bin/time -v python3 -I /workspace/submission/main.py < /workspace/tmp/stress.json > /workspace/tmp/stress.out 2> /workspace/tmp/stress.time || true
cat /workspace/tmp/stress.time | egrep 'Elapsed|User time|System time|Maximum resident'
wc -c /workspace/tmp/stress.out
python3 - <<'PY'

PY
